主要内容: On January 11, 2016, Geospace Technologies Corporation issued a press release announcing cost reductions. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The company's announcement is part of its ongoing efforts to streamline operations and improve efficiency. The press release details the measures taken to reduce costs, which may include restructuring, operational adjustments, or other cost-saving initiatives. The company did not provide specific financial details or projections in the press release. The announcement was made in accordance with Regulation FD disclosure requirements. The press release is available as an exhibit to the Form 8-K filing. The company's management, including Thomas T. McEntire, Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary, signed the report on January 11, 2016.
